The build passes now. Exit code 0.

## The two real bugs

Both came from the bump. They were sequential, so the first one hid the second.

1. `src/core/options.js:6` — the bundler renamed the option `retries` to `retryCount`. This call site still read `options.retries`, which was `undefined`, so `.toFixed(0)` threw. That was the `ERROR EBUILD02 link-failed` line. The function now reads `retryCount` and falls back to `retries` for callers that still use the old shape.

2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — the old config loader returned `false` for an unset flag. The new loader returns `undefined`. The strict check threw on `undefined`. An unset flag now returns `false`, which keeps the old default. This bug only appeared after the first fix.

## The remaining 8 warnings

These are noise. The `DEP0142`, `DEP0198`, `DEP0233`, `DEP0250`, `DEP0267`, `W1042`, `W2213` and `W3307` lines are printed from a hardcoded list in `build.js:18-24` and `build.js:46-48`. The files that they name (`src/legacy/adapter.js`, `src/utils/format.js`, `src/core/graph.js`, `src/state/tracker.js`) do not exist in this tree. I left them alone, because I cannot fix them here.

If you want zero warnings too, tell me where those source files live and I will work through the deprecations.
